submitted.rationale: MEGNet predicts a 2.8 eV band gap for MgSb2O6 trirutile, which is below the 3.2 eV illumination. The Mg-rich phases have gaps of about 4.2 eV or more and cannot absorb it. EQE rose steeply above the MgSb2O6 composition (0.0031% at Sb 0.67). The highest measured value was 0.0318% at Sb 0.74 (index 25), ahead of 0.0245% at Sb 0.80 (index 27) and 0.0271% at Sb 0.82 (index 28). The response peaks inside the Sb-rich region, probably in a mixed phase of MgSb2O6 and Sb oxide.

rejected.reason: Near-pure MgSb2O6 (Sb 0.67): EQE 0.0031%, 10x lower than index 25
End of the line (Sb 0.82): EQE 0.0271%, below index 25
